description: Trigger evals for devrites-interview — model-invoked one-question-at-a-time intent extraction (best-guess + structured options, stop at ~95% confidence) when the ask is underspecified, before any spec/plan/code exists.

queries.text: interview me about what I actually want before we start
queries.rationale: Description names 'interview me'.

queries.text: grill me on this so I can figure out what I'm really asking for
queries.rationale: Description names 'grill me'; framing is intent extraction, not stress-testing a formed plan.

queries.text: honestly I'm not sure what I want here — help me pull it out
queries.rationale: Description names 'I'm not sure what I want'.

queries.text: ask me one question at a time until you understand the requirement
queries.rationale: One-question-per-turn protocol is this skill's core.

queries.text: this feature request is way underspecified — pin down what I mean before we spec it
queries.rationale: Underspecified ask flagged before /rite-spec routes here.

queries.text: the ask is too fuzzy to plan — extract the real requirement from me first
queries.rationale: Underspecified ask flagged before /rite-define routes here.

queries.text: give me your best guess plus options on each decision, one by one, until you've got it
queries.rationale: Best-guess + structured-options protocol matches exactly.

queries.text: keep questioning me until you're about 95% sure what I mean
queries.rationale: Names the ~95% confidence stop condition.

queries.text: I described a contact page but never decided the details — draw them out of me
queries.rationale: Vague one-line ask = decision-tree mapping via interview.

queries.text: close the gap between what I said and what I actually want before any code exists
queries.rationale: Restates the skill's own purpose — extract intent at the cheapest moment.

queries.text: I keep flip-flopping on requirements — interrogate me until it's nailed down
queries.rationale: Oblique but clear request to extract settled intent.

queries.text: drag the actual spec out of my head with targeted questions before we plan anything
queries.rationale: Oblique pre-plan intent extraction is interview's lane.

queries.text: ideate with me — give me 3-5 radically different options for this rough idea
queries.rationale: Ideation/divergence is rite-pressure-test, the skill's explicit Not-for.

queries.text: build the next slice of the active feature
queries.rationale: Implementing a slice is /rite-build, not intent extraction.

queries.text: review this pull request for correctness bugs and risks
queries.rationale: Reviewing a diff is code-review (and /rite-review), not interviewing.

queries.text: debug why the build is suddenly red
queries.rationale: Diagnosing a failure is diagnose (and devrites-debug-recovery).

queries.text: I have a finished design — grill me relentlessly to find the holes in it
queries.rationale: Stress-testing an already-formed plan is grill-me, not unknown-intent extraction.
queries.owner_rationale: Stress-testing an already-formed plan is grill-me, not unknown-intent extraction.

queries.text: build this feature test-first with red-green-refactor
queries.rationale: Test-first implementation is tdd.

queries.text: prototype a throwaway UI so I can play with a few designs
queries.rationale: Throwaway prototyping is prototype (and /rite-prototype).
queries.owner_rationale: Throwaway prototyping is prototype (and /rite-prototype). The functional owner is explicit-only, so natural language has no implicit owner.

queries.text: compact this conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent
queries.rationale: Conversation handoff is handoff (and /rite-handoff).
queries.owner_rationale: Conversation handoff is handoff (and /rite-handoff). The functional owner is explicit-only, so natural language has no implicit owner.
